fact_text: Lucky Cement's stock split was approved at an extraordinary general meeting and implemented, dividing each share by five.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Comprehensive Market Analysis: HUBCO & PSX Stock Performance | Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2025-03-18)

fact_text: Lucky Cement's market capitalisation was about USD 1.6 billion at the time, and its share price was around Rs 1,500 before the split.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Comprehensive Market Analysis: HUBCO & PSX Stock Performance | Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2025-03-18)

fact_text: A stock split leaves market capitalisation and fundamentals unchanged; only the share count and the per-share price change, which can widen access for smaller investors.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Comprehensive Market Analysis: HUBCO & PSX Stock Performance | Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2025-03-18)

fact_text: The analyst said Lucky Cement's market capitalisation could rise toward the USD 2 to 3 billion range over time as the larger share count improves liquidity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Comprehensive Market Analysis: HUBCO & PSX Stock Performance | Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2025-03-18)

fact_text: The analyst expected Airlink to hold a similar stock split meeting later, following the Lucky Cement pattern.
